In the MBOOT console: usb start 1, then udstar check.txt (dry run), then udstar flash.txt. Rollback: udstar rollback.txt. The original image must stay on this same drive.

In the MBOOT console: usb start 1, then udstar backup.txt. Sizes and addresses come from the probe. The backup writes nothing to the eMMC and the TV reboots by itself at the end. Run it before flashing and copy the files to a PC right away.
Several drives are connected, the script was written to %1$s.
No external drive found. Insert a FAT32 USB drive into the TV and press the button again.
the drive already holds backups BOOT_A.IMG … BOOT_A_9.IMG, remove or move the old ones

In the MBOOT console: usb start 1, then udstar probe.txt. The script saves the partition table (PTABLE.BIN) and the environment (ENV.TXT) to the drive, writes nothing to the eMMC and reboots the TV by itself. Then press "Boot backup script for MBOOT".
the drive has no PTABLE.BIN and ENV.TXT: run "Step 1: probe script" first and start probe.txt in MBOOT
PTABLE.BIN or ENV.TXT cannot be read (no partition table or no free RAM address): run probe.txt again
the image does not fit into the free memory ENV.TXT names
no suitable boot partition in the partition table
no USB drive found. Insert a FAT32 drive into the TV.
1. The probe script is written and waits to be run in MBOOT.
1 done: the partition table and the environment are saved. Next: backup.
2. The backup script is written and waits to be run in MBOOT.
2. The backup did not verify (%1$s). Create the backup script again.
2 done: the boot partitions are saved and verified. Next: patch the image of slot %1$s.
3. The image is patched and the flash scripts are written. Next: check.txt, then flash.txt in MBOOT.
4. Flashing is done (FLASH.OK). Install Magisk and check root.
Patch the active slot image and create the flash scripts

The script %1$s is ready.

1. Open the UART terminal and hold Enter.
2. Press "Reboot the TV" (the first time the TV asks whether to allow debugging: choose "Allow", better "Always") or unplug the TV and plug it in again. Keep holding Enter until the MBOOT prompt appears.
3. Type the commands:

First check.txt (checks only, ends with CHECK_OK), and only then flash.txt. If check.txt stops at step 3 with "Invalid FAT entry", MBOOT cannot read the file from the drive: copy the RootMate files from the drive to a PC (images, *.CRC, *.txt), format the drive (FAT32) and repeat. Do not delete files from the drive that MBOOT wrote.
The TV asks to allow debugging: press "Allow" (better "Always allow").
Cannot reach the TV\'s adb. Turn on "ADB over network" in the developer settings or reboot the TV by hand.
adb did not answer. Reboot the TV by hand.
Debugging was not allowed. Allow it on the TV or reboot the TV by hand.
No verified image for the active slot (the slot is unknown or the image is not on the drive).
